name: Hoco J158 Pro Intelligent Balance 10,000mAh Power Bank
description:
Hoco J158 Pro Intelligent Balance 10,000mAh Power Bank. 
It features a 10,000mAh capacity and a slim design with a digital display.
The power bank supports fast charging protocols including 22.5W USB-A output and 20W USB-C Power Delivery (PD).
